source: ABOUT YOU outfit editorial: 'Black Zip Sweater Beige Pants Look' (everly, 2026)
pieces: black ribbed half-zip knit, ending at the waist
stone/beige relaxed straight chinos with a clean break
white adidas Samba OG (black stripes, gum sole)
formula: Short half-zip knit + relaxed stone chino + Samba
why: Nothing new, just exact proportions: the knit stops at the belt and the chino falls straight onto the shoe, so a three-piece outfit looks deliberate. The dark-over-light contrast does the rest.
fit_for_him: His half-zip + chino + Samba day, sharpened. Do it in navy or charcoal if black feels hard, keep the chino relaxed (not slim) and add the watch.

source: END. Features: 'adidas SPZL x C.P. Company' (10th-anniversary capsule lookbook, Nov 2024)
pieces: raw indigo straight jeans with a small turn-up
off-white adidas SPZL sneakers with green heel and gum sole
why: Quality fabrics: the sweatshirt has real weight and the dark raw denim makes the plain shape look premium. The green heel on the Spezial is the only accent.
fit_for_him: His sweatshirt + jeans formula done better. He should take the leg looser (baggy, not straight) and pick a plain or small-logo ecru sweatshirt; keep the silver chain.

source: ABOUT YOU outfit editorial: 'Crewneck Tee & Denim Look' (everly, 2026)
pieces: white adidas Samba OG with black stripes
formula: Coloured boxy tee + baggy jeans + Samba
why: A tonal blue outfit: the tee picks up the denim, so the most basic summer outfit looks thought through. It works because the tee is thick and the jeans are full.
fit_for_him: His boxy tee + baggy jeans + Samba uniform, with a light-blue tee in place of white. Add the cap and silver chain; a navy Samba would make it fully tonal.

source: END. Features: 'END. x adidas SPZL – By The Sea' (collection editorial, Aug 2024)
pieces: navy suede adidas SPZL Handball with green stripes
formula: Blue tee + navy trouser + navy suede Spezial + cap
why: Navy on navy with the sneaker as the only detail: the green stripes on navy suede are the one pop, as in his own outfits.
fit_for_him: His tee + trouser + Spezial outfit as a summer-night version. Swap the trousers for wide navy linen and keep the cap and chain.

source: MR PORTER The Journal: 'Real Streets, Real Style – The Men Of The Toronto Film Festival' (25 Sep 2023; photo Marc Richardson), look 03 'Youthful tonals'
pieces: white adidas with green stripes and gum sole
why: Tonal browns made young by a little green, at the neck and again on the sneaker stripes. It's the 'one colour pop at the feet' rule, repeated once higher up.
fit_for_him: Upgrades his stone/brown trouser + jacket days. A cropped taupe or brown jacket over a green tee with brown pleated trousers and green-stripe Sambas; the jacket should stay short (not a chore coat).

source: ABOUT YOU outfit editorial: 'Burgundy Zipper Black Jeans Look' (everly, 2026)
pieces: white Samba-style terrace sneakers (black stripes, gum sole)
formula: Burgundy half-zip + black jeans + Samba-style sneaker
why: Colour: burgundy is the pop here, worn on the chest, so the rest can stay black and white. A simple outfit that looks finished in photos.
fit_for_him: His half-zip + jeans formula with his favourite accent colour moved up top. Wear it with dark baggy jeans and real Sambas, and add the watch.

source: Vogue: 'The Best Street Style Photos From the Fall 2026 Menswear Shows in Milan' (Jan 2026; photo Acielle / Style Du Monde) – the man on the right
pieces: brown suede button-front blouson with patch pockets
tan suede low sneakers with white laces
formula: Brown suede blouson + white tee + ecru jeans + tan suede sneaker
why: Texture and an expensive palette: suede against pale denim in brown, ecru and white only. Simple pieces, but the suede does the work.
fit_for_him: His suede bomber + tee + jeans look in its best version. He should look for ecru or light-grey baggy jeans and brown/tan suede Premiatas or Gazelles. Ignore the man in the blazer on the left.

source: nss magazine: 'Copenhagen Fashion Week FW26 – best street style looks' (Jan 2026; photo Thomas Razzano)
pieces: tan shearling-collar aviator jacket with tan leather patches
black low sneakers with white stripes and suede toe
formula: Short shearling aviator + black wide trouser + low black sneaker
why: One special jacket over a very plain base. The cropped, warm jacket and the full black trouser show his short-top, wide-bottom proportion.
fit_for_him: Use this for his bomber/puffer slot when it's properly cold: a short shearling-collar aviator over a knit, black or charcoal baggy trousers and black Sambas. The jacket must stay waist-length, not a long coat.

source: nss magazine: 'Best street style looks – Copenhagen Fashion Week FW25' (Jan 2025; photo Christabelle Beaudry) – the man on the left
pieces: burgundy suede low sneakers with white sole
formula: Brown leather bomber + khaki relaxed trouser + burgundy suede sneaker
why: His exact palette (brown, khaki, white) with burgundy saved for the feet, a classic leather bomber with an easy trouser.
fit_for_him: Upgrades his leather-bomber formula. He should swap the cargos for relaxed pleated khaki chinos and the skate shoe for a burgundy suede Gazelle or Samba to stay in his lane. Ignore the woman on the right.
